name: BLACK-BAG
author: Khephri Labs
description: Credential command deck. Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305 vault with hybrid X25519/ML-KEM-1024 recovery recipients, an authenticated header and an anti-rollback epoch. Every secret rests encrypted in memory under a key the kernel cannot see (memfd_secret); the clipboard is served with the sensitive hint and cleared on time; suspend and screen lock seal the vault; breach checks use k-anonymity and only on request.

barWidget.description: Lock state, session countdown, and posture at a glance; click for the full-screen credential deck.

schema.label: Status poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often status.json is re-published while the shell is running. The file is watched and the agent republishes on every change, so this is a safety net.

schema.label: Treat status as stale after (seconds)
schema.description: Older than this and the widget desaturates rather than asserting a state it cannot vouch for.

schema.label: Clear clipboard after (seconds)
schema.description: How long a copied secret stays on the Wayland clipboard before it is wiped.

schema.label: On-screen reveal timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long a secret stays visible when you explicitly choose SHOW.

schema.label: Cockpit motion
schema.description: Fades and countdown sweeps. Off makes every state change snap instantly.
